# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Offloading Strategy

### Current State & Constraints
The Nemotron-H model architecture (as defined in `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) supports **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** with shared experts and routed experts, **Mamba2 SSM** layers, and **NextN/MTP** draft heads. The target GPU has **12GB VRAM**. The primary constraint is that routed expert tensors (which are typically large) must overflow to CPU RAM while keeping latency-sensitive components on GPU.

### Key Tensor Names & Memory Footprint
Based on `load_arch_tensors` and `build_arch_graph`:

| Tensor Name | Type | Shape | Offload Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layer.ffn_down_exps` | Routed Down-proj | `{n_ff_exp, moe_n_embd, n_expert}` | **CPU** (largest per-layer tensor) |
| `layer.ffn_up_exps` | Routed Up-proj | `{moe_n_embd, n_ff_exp, n_expert}` | **CPU** |
| `layer.ffn_down_shexp` | Shared Down-proj | `{n_ff_shexp, n_embd}` | **CPU** (but small: ~1/10 routed) |
| `layer.ffn_up_shexp` | Shared Up-proj | `{n_embd, n_ff_shexp}` | **CPU** |
| `layer.ssm_in`, `layer.ssm_conv1d`, `layer.ssm_out` | Mamba2 SSM | Varies; typically < 50MB per layer | **GPU** (latency-critical) |
| `layer.attn_norm`, `layer.wo` | Attention | Moderate | **GPU** |
| `layer.ffn_gate_inp`, `layer.ffn_exp_probs_b` | MoE Gate | Small | **GPU** |

**Correctness Risk**: The `build_ffn_layer` function (line ~140) unconditionally calls `build_moe_ffn` and `build_ffn` for shared experts. If expert weights reside on CPU, `ggml_mul_mat` will trigger expensive host-device transfers during
